decision.proposition: Do the supplied dependency declarations separate runtime dependencies from development tooling?

requirements.title: Choose a test organization for this project

decision.question: Which organization is appropriate for the supplied tests and project constraints? Abstain if the evidence does not support a choice.

options.description: Separate unit, integration and boundary tests into explicit directories.
Keep tests together with explicit groups and independently selectable commands.

decision.rubric: Count categories explicitly invoked by the supplied CI configuration: linting, formatting, type checking and tests. Award one point per category with an identifiable command, zero for an absent category. This is configuration coverage only; it does not verify execution, required branch checks or project readiness. Abstain if invoked commands cannot be resolved from the supplied evidence.
